questions.question: In a two-Spirit game with 7 of 8 Fear markers already generated, an effect generates 3 Fear and earning a card exposes Terror II. Explain marker handling, new Terror timing, and when the card is revealed/resolved.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: In a two-Spirit game with 7 of 8 Fear markers already generated, an effect generates 3 Fear and earning a card exposes Terror II. Explain marker handling, new Terror timing, and when the card is revealed/resolved.
required_facts: The eighth Fear marker earns the top Fear card face-down, then reset all 8 markers to the Fear Pool.
The remaining 2 generated Fear go toward the next card.
Exposed Terror II takes effect immediately.
Reveal the earned card only as it is resolved during the Invader Phase's Fear step.

key_context_not_required.fact: Outcome check occurs at action-tree end.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks marker handling, Terror timing and Fear-card reveal/resolution, not a victory/defeat check.

key_context_not_required.fact: An initial stack of earned Fear cards is resolved in earned order.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The given effect earns one card. The prompt asks its reveal/resolution time and Terror level, not the ordering of an initial multi-card earned stack.

key_context_not_required.fact: Resolve an earned Fear card using only the then-current Terror Level.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The stem asks reveal/resolution time, not which Terror-level text to use.

questions.question: How do Damage, Destroy, Remove and Replace differ for Fear and survival? Can Damage from separate normal Powers combine, does Damage normally hurt Dahan, and does replacement erase prior Damage?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: How do Damage, Destroy, Remove and Replace differ for Fear and survival? Can Damage from separate normal Powers combine, does Damage normally hurt Dahan, and does replacement erase prior Damage?
required_facts: Unqualified Power Damage normally hurts Invaders; Dahan are harmed only if explicitly stated.
Damage from normal separate Powers can combine during the turn.
Damage reaching Health immediately destroys a piece.
Destroying a Town/City causes 1/2 Fear in addition to explicit Fear.
Remove/Replace themselves generate no destruction Fear.
Replace retains prior Damage and can cause destruction if it meets the new piece's Health.
An outright Destroy instruction eliminates its specified piece regardless of current Damage or Health, unlike Damage that must reach Health.
Remove takes the specified piece off the board without requiring Damage to reach Health.
Replace removes the original piece and puts the specified replacement in its place.

key_context_not_required.fact: An ordinary Power Damage budget may be distributed among Invaders in its target land as desired.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The comparison is explicitly for Fear and survival, followed by accumulation, Dahan recipients and retained replacement Damage. It never asks how freely a Damage budget can be split among different Invaders.

questions.question: A Ravage kills a Dahan but adds no Blight because a Power prevents it. Does Sworn to Victory still destroy Thunderspeaker Presence, and before or after cascades and counterattack?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Ravage kills a Dahan but adds no Blight because a Power prevents it. Does Sworn to Victory still destroy Thunderspeaker Presence, and before or after cascades and counterattack?
required_facts: A Ravage killing Dahan still triggers Sworn to Victory even if no Blight was added.
For the one Dahan killed in this Ravage, destroy one of Thunderspeaker's Presence.
Resolve the whole single-land Ravage, including Blight/cascades and counterattack, before that Presence loss.

key_context_not_required.fact: Sworn to Victory selects the Presence to destroy within Range 1 of the Ravaged land.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks whether Sworn to Victory still triggers without Blight and whether its loss happens before or after the Ravage/cascades/counterattack. It never asks where the destroyed Presence may be chosen.

key_context_not_required.fact: For each Dahan destroyed by a Ravage, Sworn to Victory destroys one of Thunderspeaker's Presence as instructed.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The actual premise kills one Dahan. The general per-Dahan multiplier is background beyond this case.

questions.question: Bringer uses a 2-Damage Power and then a separate 1-Damage Power on an undamaged City. What happens? What if 2 then 1 Damage are instructions within a single Power, and may a Repeat pretend-destroy the same piece again?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Bringer uses a 2-Damage Power and then a separate 1-Damage Power on an undamaged City. What happens? What if 2 then 1 Damage are instructions within a single Power, and may a Repeat pretend-destroy the same piece again?
required_facts: Separate 2- and 1-Damage Bringer Powers each fail to pretend-destroy an undamaged City and leave no hypothetical Damage.
A single Power with 2 then 1 Damage combines its instructions and pretend-destroys that City for 5 Fear without actual destruction.
A Repeat is a separate use and can pretend-destroy the same piece again if that use suffices.
Hypothetical Damage cannot combine across the original and Repeat.
